cards.card_text: Sling a stone at a hair without missing Shoot an arrow through a ring Throw a spear across a river
cards.verse_text: Among all these soldiers there were 700 select left-handers, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair without missing.
cards.snippet: …all these soldiers there were 700 select left-handers, each of whom could sling a stone at a hair without missing.

cards.verse_text: And with his sling in hand, he approached the Philistine.
cards.snippet: And with his sling in hand, he approached the Philistine.

cards.card_text: If anyone comes after David's life, she says the LORD will keep it bound securely in the bundle of the living, and his enemies will be flung away "like stones from a sling."
cards.verse_text: But He shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.
cards.snippet: …shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.

cards.card_text: They're archers who sling stones AND shoot arrows.
cards.verse_text: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):
cards.snippet: they were archers using both the right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows; and they were Saul’s kinsmen from Benjamin):

cards.card_text: Then Solomon says giving honor to a fool is like binding a stone into a sling.
cards.verse_text: Like binding a stone into a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.
cards.snippet: Like binding a stone into a sling is the giving of honor to a fool.

cards.card_text: Then He'll roll Shebna into a ball and sling him away.
cards.verse_text: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land.
cards.snippet: roll you into a ball, and sling you into a wide land.

cards.card_text: The LORD says He'll sling the people out of the land at this time.
cards.verse_text: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”
